frontier.label: R44BA
frontier.result: proved one-step exact polynomial coverage for every nonempty width<=3 state with surplus <=2

R44BA.theorem: If F is nonempty Boolean CNF, max width <=3, and sigma(F)<=2, one deterministic polynomial SAT-preserving transition strictly decreases n(F)+c(F).

cases.sigma in {1,2} and mu_vd>nM(sigma): constructive width-3 critical autarky from R44AO
cases.otherwise: nM(1)=2 and nM(2)=4 imply a minimum-degree variable satisfies p*q<=p+q, so R44AT nonexpanding exact DP applies

R44BA.scope_ceiling: ONE_STEP_ONLY. DP can create width-4 clauses, so the successor need not remain in the R44BA hypothesis.
R44BA.frontier_effect: any nonempty width<=3 state irreducible under these exact rules has sigma>=3; at sigma=3 the first unsafe degree-five polarity profile is (3,2)/(2,3)

next_question: Find a polynomially computable exact transition or terminal theorem for the sigma>=3, especially (3,2)/(2,3), width-3 rigid core without DP-budget escalation, recursive branching, proof-search, or hidden terminal SAT.
